Transwestern's average deliveries to California were 1011 MMBtu/d (93%), with San Juan lateral throughput at 872 MMBtu/d.  Total East deliveries averaged 337 MMBtu/d.  

El Paso's average deliveries to California were 2065 MMBtu/d (71%):
- PG&ETop, capacity of 1140 MMBtu/d, deliveries of 542 MMBtu/d (48%)
- SoCalEhr, capacity 1250 MMBtu/d, deliveries of 1035 MMBtu/d (83%)
- SoCalTop, capacity 540 MMBtu/d, deliveries of 488 MMBtu/d (90%)
